title: Four-tier Freed ID flashcard schema with owner anchor, Trinity pillar, bounded practice, and task-card referential integrity

content.hypothesis: A strict four-tier schema can make phase context addressable without converting relational identity into personhood or authority.
content.null_or_failure_condition: Any card bypasses a tier, accepts a raw private identifier, or treats an identity anchor as evidence of consciousness, continuity, or authority.
content.execution_lane: x2 owner-local structural, synthetic, symbolic, or software evidence only
content.official_or_primary_source_needs: Official OpenAI prompt-caching guidance for ordering context only; schema semantics are locally declared.
content.falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Reject unless the declared fixture passes, every negative mutation is retained, and the output makes no claim beyond its evidence class.
content.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the failed card or deck, preserve the witness, restore the last valid content-addressed manifest, and rerun only the failed dependency.

relational_boundary: Working-language record only; not consciousness, personhood, identity continuity, qualification, or authority evidence.
